en.hubeali:
Ahmad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Yunus Bin Yaqoub, from the one who informed him, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Whoever performs Tawaaf (circumambulation) between the two stones, Al-Safa and Al-Marwa, would be out of the state of (from Ihraam), unless he is ushering the sacrificial animal’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ahmad has narrated from al-Hassan ibn Ali from Yunus ibn Ya’qub from those who narrated to him who has said the following: “Abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Whoever performs Tawaf between these two stones, al- Safa’ and al-Marwah, is out of the state of Ihram unless he has driven the offering animal along with him.’”
